description: R08 functional-debt checkpoint: close the complete TIL u8u16convertTests family with explicit incremental UTF-8/UTF-16 conversion state and direct Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: Safe Rust reproduces Microsoft's complete UTF-8 to UTF-16 vector, including the four-byte CJK scalar encoded as a surrogate pair.
Safe Rust reproduces Microsoft's complete UTF-16 to UTF-8 vector byte-for-byte.
Utf8ToUtf16State retains incomplete multibyte prefixes across calls and reproduces both Microsoft split-sequence vectors, including GH#4673.
Utf16ToUtf8State retains a trailing high surrogate and completes the scalar when the low surrogate arrives in the next chunk.
Incremental UTF-8 state emits no output for the first three CAMERA bytes and emits the exact surrogate pair only when the fourth byte arrives.
